requirements.title: Namelist records consist of name-value subsequences with equals and blank normalization
requirements.definition: Namelist records form name-value subsequences consisting of object designator, equals, and values/separators; equals may have surrounding blanks; outside character constants record end acts as blank and multiple blanks collapse.

pending.object-equals-values: Internal READ from namelist record '&G I=7 /' into NAMELIST /G/ I; expected I=7.
pending.equals-surrounding-blanks: Internal READ record '&G I = 7 /'; expected I=7.
pending.namelist-record-end-as-blank: Internal READ records ['&G I=7', '/']; expected I=7 with record end acting as a blank outside constants.
pending.namelist-multiple-blanks-collapse: Internal READ record '&G   I   =   7   /'; expected I=7.

requirements.title: Namelist object designators are restricted designators rooted in group objects
requirements.definition: Each namelist input object designator begins with a namelist group object name, follows designator syntax, excludes vector subscripts, image selectors, zero-sized arrays/sections, and zero-length character strings; subscript/stride/range expressions are optionally signed integer literal constants without kind; section subscript count equals rank; derived-type components may be qualified successively; optional blanks may surround but not be embedded in the designator.

pending.root-group-object-name: With NAMELIST /G/ A, internal READ '&G A=1 /'; expected A=1. An unknown root name is a separate name-resolution failure and not this positive facet.
pending.designator-syntax: With integer array A(2), internal READ '&G A(2)=5 /'; expected A(2)=5.
pending.no-vector-subscript: Deferred negative: '&G A([1])=5 /' differs from scalar subscript control only by vector-subscript use; do not combine with rank or syntax repairs.
pending.no-image-selector: Deferred negative for coarray-capable owner: image-selector in namelist input designator differs from control only by image selection; current single-image suite should not execute it.
pending.no-zero-sized-designation: Deferred: requires a declared zero-sized array/section context; observe input error only if Clause 12/8 ownership supplies portable setup.
pending.literal-subscript-stride-range: Internal READ '&G A(1:2)=3,4 /' into integer A(2); expected [3,4]. Negative uses variable subscript only if isolated from expression parsing dependencies.
pending.section-subscript-rank: For rank-one A, '&G A(1:2)=3,4 /' is valid; a two-subscript section is a future isolated negative.
pending.derived-component-qualification: For NAMELIST /G/ T with component C, internal READ '&G T%C=9 /'; expected T%C=9.
pending.no-embedded-designator-blanks: Deferred negative: '&G A (1)=5 /' differs from '&G A(1)=5 /' only by an embedded designator blank.

review_rationale: Independent fresh-context source review, two rounds: doc/source_audits/batch_139.json. This COMPLETES the list-directed and namelist half of Clause 13. The reviewer re-derived unit hashes, re-partitioned the four sections sharing PDF p312 unit by unit, verified the zero-numbered-R/C claim across all 77 units, re-read both note result tables row-by-row (13.10.3.2 NOTE 3 and 13.11.3.6 NOTE), and confirmed 13.10.4 contains no table despite being the flagged candidate. THE CRUX of this scope is the REQUIRED versus PROCESSOR-DEPENDENT split, and the reviewer audited it in BOTH directions, producing two blocking findings that are the same error in mirror image. C139SR-001: the F/E choice for real list-directed output was marked WHOLLY processor-dependent, but 13.10.4 p5 fixes one case - a real ZERO must use F form - so the claim was TOO BROAD, which is itself a defect; the unit is now split, with a required facet asserting ONLY the form (no E-form exponent marker) and explicitly not the width, digits, sign or decimal spelling, and 13.11.4.2 propagating it through namelist editing. C139SR-002 ran the other way: a plan asserted the exact substring I= while the same packet marked spacing around equals processor-dependent, and a conforming processor may emit I with a space; the plan now asserts the uppercase object-name token only. The genuine obligations survive and were hand-verified including their leading blanks: ' T' and ' F' from 13.10.4 p3 with p13, ' AB' for delimiter mode NONE from p8, and the namelist prefix ' &G' from 13.11.4.3 p3 and p5. Source accounting only: authored_facets unchanged at 1977, no fixture bound, no compiler invoked.
